0.0: It's been a while since I last saw you. How have you been? Not everything is going well here in Perion. A few days ago, a group of tribesmen went hunting to the swamps near Kerning City to acquire some alligator skins, only to be ambushed by them. They came back alive, but all were seriously injured.
0.1: People haven't been going to the swamps for quite some time, and during that time, the number of the alligators have dramatically increased to the point where they are starting to attack people. Even Dances with Balrog has taken notice, and he has been just as concerned about it as us.

yes.0: Thank you. Because of the recent string of events, Dances with Balrog decided to hire someone to take care of the alligators. He is a very busy man, though, so I have assumed the task of hiring someone to help us, and I choose you. Please head over to the swamps and take out #r8 #o3110100#s#k and #r10 #o2130103#s#k, then bring back #b5 #t4000034#s#k as evidence.
yes.1: The swamps can be reached through the Subway in Kerning City. I have utmost faith in you. But please be careful! The alligators are very violent.

no.0: You looked powerful enough to handle the task, at least in my eyes. Please reconsider your choice, because...if the alligators keep spawning like they do right now at the swamps, it'll be really dangerous for everyone here down the road..

1.0: You're back early! That's incredible! I knew I had asked the right person for the job. Thanks to you the number of the alligators at the swamps should be considerably less now. Thank goodness...
1.1: Did you bring #b#t4000034##k with you? I also have something for you as a sign of my appreciation for our hard work. Which of these do you need?

yes.0: #b#t4000034##k can also be used as a medicine. I wanted you to bring it so I could use it on people that have been attacked by the alligators. This scroll is our way of saying thanks, so please take it and put it to good use.

item.0: Please head over to the swamps and take out #r8 #o3110100#s#k and #r10 #o2130103#s#k, then bring back #b5 #t4000034#s#k as evidence.

QuestInfo.name: Taking Out the Alligators 1
QuestInfo.0: I heard something happened to the tribesmen of Perion. I should go talk to Ayan about this.
QuestInfo.1:
You meet Ayan in Perion, and she tells you that a few days ago, a group of tribesmen went hunting in the swamps and wound up being ambushed by a group of alligators. She's very worried about the sudden surge of alligators taking over the swamps and wants you to eliminate them before they spawn out of control. You'll have to kill #b8 #o3110100#s#k and #b10 #o2130103#s#k while collecting #b5 #t4000034#s#k along the way.
